objective: Perform the first live AgentOS end-to-end communication handshake and return a correlated response proving receipt, execution, evidence, and readiness for follow-up delegation.
scope: verify target identity and delegated authority
state exactly what was read and the evidence observed
constraints: do not modify application source code
do not grant or assume authority
do not consume paid external credits for work that can be completed by repository inspection
acceptance_criteria: task is received with the exact task_id agentos-e2e-001
a real repository read is performed
response contains task_id, responder, status, result, evidence, next_action and created_at
response status is completed only if all criteria are evidenced
response requests a follow-up task or states none
